mapper.select: /* MobCargoMapper.selectCargoDetailByCarryIn : 화물조회 - 화물 상세 조회 By 반입 */ SELECT I.OD_JOB_NO, I.CT, /* 수량 */ I.WT, /* 중량 */ I.LOCATION_PLACE, /* 장치위치 1) */ ISNULL(LOC.NAME_KOR,'') AS LOCATION_PLACE_NAME, /* 장치위치 2) */ ISNULL(CD.NAME_DEFAULT,'') AS CD_TYPE_NAME, /* 화물구분 1) */ I.BIG_SIZE_YN, /* 화물구분 2) */ I.REMARKS_1 , /* 화물구분 3) */ ISNULL(SIC.NAME_DEFAULT,'') AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE_NAME, /* 검사구분 1) */ ISNULL(SIC2.NAME_DEFAULT,'') AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE_NAME, /* 검사구분 2) */ ISNULL(SIC3.NAME_DEFAULT,'') AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE_NAME, /* 검사구분 3) */ ISNULL(LIR.INSPECTION_FINISH_YN,'') AS INSPECTION_FINISH_YN, /* 검사구분 4) */ CASE WHEN ISNULL(H.CNT,0) = 1 THEN H.HOLD_REASON WHEN ISNULL(H.CNT,0) > 1 THEN H.HOLD_REASON + ' 외'+ CAST(H.CNT-1 AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END AS HOLD_REASON, /* 홀드사유 1) */ H.HOLD_RELEASE_YN, /* 홀드사유 2) */ ISNULL(POD1.NAME_DEFAULT,'') AS LAST_POD_STATUS_NAME, /* 진행상태 1) */ ISNULL(POD2.NAME_DEFAULT,'') AS LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS_NAME, /* 진행상태 2) */ CASE WHEN ISNULL(OP.APPROVAL_CLASS,'') = 31 THEN '승인' WHEN ISNULL(OP.APPROVAL_CLASS,'') = 1 THEN '취하' ELSE '' END AS APPROVAL_CLASS, /* 진행상태 3) */ ISNULL(O.O_POD_STATUS_NAME,'') AS O_POD_STATUS_NAME, /* 진행상태 4) */ SUBSTRING(I.AR_DATE + ' ' + I.AR_TIME, 3, LEN(I.AR_DATE + ' ' + I.AR_TIME)) AS AR_DATE_TIME , /* 입항일시 1) */ SUBSTRING(I.CARRYIN_DATE+ ' ' + I.CARRYIN_TIME, 3, LEN(I.CARRYIN_DATE+ ' ' + I.CARRYIN_TIME)) AS CARRYIN_DATE_TIME, /* 입항일시 2) */ SUBSTRING(ISNULL(OP.NOTIFY_DATE_TIME,''), 3, LEN(ISNULL(OP.NOTIFY_DATE_TIME,''))) AS NOTIFY_DATE_TIME, /* 승인일시 1) */ CASE WHEN ISNULL(O.O_CNT,0) > 1 THEN '분할' ELSE SUBSTRING(ISNULL(O.CARRYOUT_DATE_TIME, ''), 3, LEN(ISNULL(O.CARRYOUT_DATE_TIME, ''))) END AS CARRYOUT_DATE_TIME, /* 승인일시 2) */ I.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, /* 품명 */ I.SHIPPER_NAME, /* 송하인 */ I.CONSIGNEE_NAME, /* 수하인 */ I.CONSIGNEE_TEL, /* 수하인전화번호 */ I.XRAY_IMAGE_CT, /* 판독수량 */ I.DELIVERY_NAME, /* 배송사 */ CASE WHEN ISNULL(OP.APPROVAL_CLASS,'') = 31 THEN SUBSTRING(OP.OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME, 3, LEN(OP.OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME)) ELSE '' END AS OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME /* 출고 */ FROM TB_BMS_IN I WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN (SELECT O.IN_NO ,COUNT(*) AS O_CNT ,MAX(ISNULL(POD3.NAME_DEFAULT,'')) AS O_POD_STATUS_NAME ,MAX(O.CARRYOUT_DATE + ' ' + O.CARRYOUT_TIME) AS CARRYOUT_DATE_TIME FROM TB_BMS_OUT O WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL POD3 ON O.LAST_POD_STATUS = POD3.CODE AND POD3.GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' GROUP BY O.IN_NO ) O ON I.IN_NO = O.IN_NO AND I.IN_NO > 0 LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL LOC ON I.LOCATION_PLACE = LOC.CODE AND LOC.GROUP_CODE = 'WH_LOCATION' LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL CD ON I.CD_TYPE = CD.CODE AND CD.GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE' LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL SIC ON I.SE_INSPECTION_CODE = SIC.CODE AND SIC.GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL SIC2 ON I.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = SIC2.CODE AND SIC2.GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL SIC3 ON I.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = SIC3.CODE AND SIC3.GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(APPROVAL_CLASS) AS APPROVAL_CLASS ,MAX(CONVERT(VARCHAR,NOTIFY_DATE_TIME,20)) AS NOTIFY_DATE_TIME ,MAX(CONVERT(VARCHAR,OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME,20)) AS OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME ,IN_NO FROM TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY IN_NO) OP ON I.IN_NO = OP.IN_NO AND I.IN_NO > 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT OD_JOB_NO, COUNT(*) AS CNT, MAX(HIC.NAME_KOR) AS HOLD_REASON, MIN(HOLD_RELEASE_YN) AS HOLD_RELEASE_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD H LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL HIC ON H.HOLD_CODE = HIC.CODE AND HIC.GROUP_CODE = 'HOLD_CODE' GROUP BY OD_JOB_NO) AS H ON I.OD_JOB_NO = H.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT OD_JOB_NO, MAX(CAST(DIM_WIDTH AS VARCHAR) + '*' + CAST(DIM_HEIGHT AS VARCHAR) + '*' + CAST(DIM_HEIGHT AS VARCHAR)) AS DIM FROM TB_ECM_OD_ITEM GROUP BY OD_JOB_NO) AS ITEM ON I.OD_JOB_NO = ITEM.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT LIR ON I.IN_NO = LIR.IN_NO LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL POD1 ON I.LAST_POD_STATUS = POD1.CODE AND POD1.GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL POD2 ON I.LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS = POD2.CODE AND POD2.GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' WHERE I.IN_NO = #{srchNo}

/* MobCargoMapper.selectCargoDetailByInPlan : 화물조회 - 화물 상세 조회 By 반입예정 */ SELECT P.OD_JOB_NO, P.EX_CT AS CT, /* 수량 */ P.EX_WT AS WT, /* 중량 */ '' AS LOCATION_PLACE, /* 장치위치 1) */ '' AS LOCATION_PLACE_NAME, /* 장치위치 2) */ ISNULL(CD.NAME_DEFAULT,'') AS CD_TYPE_NAME, /* 화물구분 1) */ P.BIG_SIZE_YN, /* 화물구분 2) */ '' AS REMARKS_1 , /* 화물구분 3) */ ISNULL(SIC.NAME_DEFAULT,'') AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE_NAME, /* 검사구분 1) */ '' AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE_NAME, /* 검사구분 2) */ '' AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE_NAME, /* 검사구분 3) */ '' AS INSPECTION_FINISH_YN, /* 검사구분 4) */ CASE WHEN ISNULL(H.CNT,0) = 1 THEN H.HOLD_REASON WHEN ISNULL(H.CNT,0) > 1 THEN H.HOLD_REASON + ' 외'+ CAST(H.CNT-1 AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END AS HOLD_REASON, /* 홀드사유 1) */ H.HOLD_RELEASE_YN, /* 홀드사유 2) */ '' AS LAST_POD_STATUS_NAME, /* 진행상태 1) */ '' AS LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS_NAME, /* 진행상태 2) */ '' AS APPROVAL_CLASS, /* 진행상태 3) */ '' AS O_POD_STATUS_NAME, /* 진행상태 4) */ P.AR_DATE + ' ' + P.AR_TIME AS AR_DATE_TIME , /* 입항일시 1) */ '' AS CARRYIN_DATE_TIME, /* 입항일시 2) */ '' AS NOTIFY_DATE_TIME, /* 승인일시 1) */ '' AS CARRYOUT_DATE_TIME, /* 승인일시 2) */ P.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, /* 품명 */ P.SHIPPER_NAME, /* 송하인 */ P.CONSIGNEE_NAME, /* 수하인 */ P.CONSIGNEE_TEL,/* 수하인전화번호 */ X.XRAY_IMAGE_CT, /* 판독수량 */ P.DELIVERY_NAME, /* 배송사 */ '' AS OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME /* 출고 */ FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN P WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_XRAY_RESULT X ON P.IN_PLAN_NO = X.IN_PLAN_NO AND P.IN_PLAN_NO > 0 LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL CD ON P.CD_TYPE = CD.CODE AND CD.GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE' LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL SIC ON P.SE_INSPECTION_CODE = SIC.CODE AND SIC.GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' LEFT JOIN (SELECT OD_JOB_NO, COUNT(*) AS CNT, MAX(HIC.NAME_KOR) AS HOLD_REASON, MIN(HOLD_RELEASE_YN) AS HOLD_RELEASE_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD H LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL HIC ON H.HOLD_CODE = HIC.CODE AND HIC.GROUP_CODE = 'HOLD_CODE' GROUP BY OD_JOB_NO) AS H ON P.OD_JOB_NO = H.OD_JOB_NO WHERE P.IN_PLAN_NO = #{srchNo}

/* MobCargoMapper.selectCargoDetailByOrder : 화물조회 - 화물 상세 조회 By 오더 */ SELECT O.OD_JOB_NO, O.PIECES AS CT, /* 수량 */ O.GWT AS WT, /* 중량 */ '' AS LOCATION_PLACE, /* 장치위치 1) */ '' AS LOCATION_PLACE_NAME, /* 장치위치 2) */ ISNULL(CD.NAME_DEFAULT,'') AS CD_TYPE_NAME, /* 화물구분 1) */ '' AS BIG_SIZE_YN, /* 화물구분 2) */ '' AS REMARKS_1 , /* 화물구분 3) */ ISNULL(SIC.NAME_DEFAULT,'') AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE_NAME, /* 검사구분 1) */ '' AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE_NAME, /* 검사구분 2) */ '' AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE_NAME, /* 검사구분 3) */ '' AS INSPECTION_FINISH_YN, /* 검사구분 4) */ CASE WHEN ISNULL(H.CNT,0) = 1 THEN H.HOLD_REASON WHEN ISNULL(H.CNT,0) > 1 THEN H.HOLD_REASON + ' 외'+ CAST(H.CNT-1 AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END AS HOLD_REASON, /* 홀드사유 1) */ H.HOLD_RELEASE_YN, /* 홀드사유 2) */ '' AS LAST_POD_STATUS_NAME, /* 진행상태 1) */ '' AS LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS_NAME, /* 진행상태 2) */ '' AS APPROVAL_CLASS, /* 진행상태 3) */ '' AS O_POD_STATUS_NAME, /* 진행상태 4) */ CONVERT(VARCHAR,O.AR_DATE,21) + ' ' + O.AR_TIME AS AR_DATE_TIME , /* 입항일시 1) */ '' AS CARRYIN_DATE_TIME, /* 입항일시 2) */ '' AS NOTIFY_DATE_TIME, /* 승인일시 1) */ '' AS CARRYOUT_DATE_TIME, /* 승인일시 2) */ OA.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, /* 품명 */ O.SHIPPER_NAME, /* 송하인 */ O.CONSIGNEE_NAME, /* 수하인 */ O.CONSIGNEE_TEL, /* 수하인전화번호 */ 0 AS XRAY_IMAGE_CT, /* 판독수량 */ O.DELIVERY_NAME, /* 배송사 */ '' AS OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME /* 출고 */ FROM TB_ECM_OD O LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL OA ON O.OD_JOB_NO = OA.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL CD ON O.CD_TYPE = CD.CODE AND CD.GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE' LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL SIC ON OA.SE_INSPECTION_CODE = SIC.CODE AND SIC.GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' LEFT JOIN (SELECT OD_JOB_NO, COUNT(*) AS CNT, MAX(HIC.NAME_KOR) AS HOLD_REASON, MIN(HOLD_RELEASE_YN) AS HOLD_RELEASE_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD H LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL HIC ON H.HOLD_CODE = HIC.CODE AND HIC.GROUP_CODE = 'HOLD_CODE' GROUP BY OD_JOB_NO) AS H ON O.OD_JOB_NO = H.OD_JOB_NO WHERE O.OD_JOB_NO = #{srchNo}
